name: General Mills Original Cheerios (Toasted Oat O's)
whyItWorks: Made from finely milled whole grain oat flour, pureed and toasted into crisp rings that dissolve immediately in milk. Unlike raw oats, the beta-glucan soluble fiber is smooth and helps bind stool without scratching inflamed tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour into a bowl with cold lactose-free milk, almond milk, or oat milk. Let sit for 60 seconds to soften before eating.
watchOuts: Contains soluble oat fiber; enjoy in standard 1-cup portions.
